proof_attempt_summary: The original unchanged graph-distance HAC claim was rejected after the random-metric route failed to converge, and the run lawfully pivoted to an observable two-wave diagnostic. The discharged D0 core proves cross-wave identification, finite-sample concentration and testing, an exactly unbiased lag-separated statistic, Følner/Cayley extensions, and sharp balanced-design score/full-record minimax rates with Janson's coboundary theorem attested from the source. A bounded field-upgrade pass still scored subfield; reaching field would require a new arbitrary-propensity least-favourable construction plus an empirical simulation program.
tldr: Two conditionally independent assignment waves on one no-carryover schedule identify the Palm population covariance through observable cross-wave IPW products. A joint assignment--innovation cylinder version, common to every assignment outside one null set, explicitly induces every finite exposure, outcome, propensity, and score coordinate on the buffered interior. Explicit radius-one Rademacher witnesses use the Borel cylinders \(\Psi^{\Delta}(u,x)=(x_0,(u_0-u_{-1})x_0)\) and \(\Psi^+(u,x)=(x_0,u_0x_0)\) with the single null set empty; they show that zero long-run variance can coexist with heterogeneous local scores and that the positive-variance alternative is nonempty. These primitives give order-\(n^{-1}\) centering bias and root-\(n\) finite-sample concentration, size and power, and an exactly unbiased lag-separated statistic. A verified four-cell local schedule has common support at the level of the complete buffered graph--assignment--exposure--outcome record and proves a matching full-observation minimax lower bound. Thus, for distinct focal labels, both the full-observation and score-vector separation radii are \(\Theta(n^{-1/2})\) for fixed \(r,B,\varepsilon,\alpha,\beta\), \(p=1/2\), and \(\alpha+\beta<1\).
gap: Janson2015 exactly classifies the zero-long-run-variance boundary for finite block factors, while existing network-interference papers analyze effect estimation or variance estimation from one randomization. None supplies an observable, uniformly size-controlled test of whether the Palm population component itself vanishes.
fill: The project defines the complete two-wave statistic and nuisance means, proves an explicit concentration inequality, derives finite-sample size and power guarantees at an attainable root-sample-size separation, and leaves only the sharp minimax rate as open content.
